defective_pattern: Failing to commit to the harnessed/screened sample size (N) in downstream micro-stages, resulting in discordant N values between methodology, descriptive statistics, and inferential tests.
why_defective: Once data screening (e.g., outlier removal, missing data exclusion) establishes a final analytic sample, using the original pre-screened N in subsequent chapters creates severe statistical discordance, invalid degrees of freedom, and fatal methodological flaws.
observed_symptoms: Degrees of freedom in statistical outputs do not align with the reported N.
Chapter 3 states one sample size while Chapter 4 uses another without explicit justification of exclusion.
Micro-stages use different N values because they reload the raw dataset instead of the harnessed dataset.
corrective_remedy: Strictly commit to the 'Harnessed N' after screening. All subsequent empirical chapters, micro-stages, and statistical tests must exclusively use the harnessed dataset and report this final N cases.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect inconsistent references to pre-screening sample sizes in analysis results
